certainty.help: A reader's answer counts as yes if p(yes) >= c, as no if p(yes) <= 1 - c, else unclear. Higher c = more unclear facts = more calls to review.

combination.label: Agreement
combination.help: Both readers yes -> yes, both no -> no, otherwise unclear (the review rules apply).

combination.label: Qwen, Kev as check
combination.help: Qwen decides, unless Kev clearly says the opposite -> unclear.

combination.label: Qwen only
combination.help: Only Qwen counts; Kev's answer is shown but does not decide.

combination.label: Kev only
combination.help: Only Kev counts; Qwen's answer is shown but does not decide.

threshold.help: Call score at or above this is an alarm; within the review band below it, review.
